name: weavatrix
description: Native, read-only repository intelligence for coding agents through MCP.

interface.longDescription: Inspect code graphs, dependencies, APIs, architecture, Git history, impact, duplicates, dead code, coverage, and source evidence without granting source-write access.
defaultPrompt: Map this repository and identify its main modules.
Assess the impact and tests for my current changes.
Audit architecture, duplicates, and dead-code candidates.
